sources.evidence: Notice 2026-06-01: v4 FBS list and unfulfilled/list replace v3 list methods; old versions disabled 2026-08-01. This confirms endpoint versions, not field schemas.
Notice 2026-02-06: /v2/warehouse/list and /v2/delivery-method/list replace v1 on 2026-03-20. The older Express article still names v1 delivery-method/list; this later notice takes precedence.

Notice 2026-09-18: new label task creation is /v3/posting/fbs/package-label/create and retrieval /v2/posting/fbs/package-label/get. The four previous label methods are disabled 2026-11-02. Scanit is added to v3 get and v4 list/unfulfilled. Full JSON envelopes and limits are not verified by this notice.

Article 2025-11-06 distinguishes rFBS Express aggregator delivery to Ozon or aggregator pickup points and non-integrated delivery using polygons. Warehouse/delivery creation methods do not establish permission for posting status transitions.
The supplied short URL returned no accessible document. No endpoint, field, or transition guarantee is inferred from this source.

Checked with web reader: no readable schema content. Direct unauthenticated documentation download encountered HTTP 307 redirect loop. Current Seller API request/response schemas remain unverified; no provider API was called.

Actual third-party SDK snapshot checked. It still uses /v2 label create and /v1 label get and cannot verify the new label schemas. Updating positions replaces the collection. Price is in minor currency units; document sum and shipped/reserved/payment totals are read-only.
